name: Melonds
tagline: Aims at providing fast and accurate Nintendo DS emulation.
description: melonDS aims at providing fast and accurate Nintendo DS emulation.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/melonds:1.1.20261229@sha256:1b5a28a03910688f5a44236f1c5afe49ad29ff497ba55614e08e5e6d7a5a1e49
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
